What the calm doesn't reflect is what it took to get here: extraordinary swings in single stocks, a record spread between S&P and Nasdaq 100 volatility, and a 25% pullback in the semiconductor group that had traders rushing to buy more puts than at any point in the history of the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH).
